results.title: Fired OpenAI safety researchers dispute their dismissals in open letter
results.snippet: Three OpenAI safety researchers have posted an open letter to OpenAI disputing their dismissals. Jasmine Wang , Mikita Balesni and Tomek Korbak wrote that the "very public manner" of the company's communications around the firings could have a "chilling" effect on employees at a time when "the world's safety depends on them."

results.title: OpenAI to bring in $20 billion less than previously expected
results.snippet: According to a new report from the Financial Times, OpenAI has informed investors that the company is expected to make $50 billion in revenue for the year. That's a lot of money, but it's also a full $20 billion less than earlier projections from just last month, which predicted the company would earn $70 billion in annual revenue.

results.title: OpenAI’s Revenue Is Reportedly $20 Billion Lower Than Thought. Nvidia Just Lost $170 Billion
results.snippet: A $20 billion accounting gap in OpenAI's revenue figures sent shockwaves through chip stocks on October 8, wiping out billions in market value across Nvidia, CoreWeave, Oracle, and others. The twist is that no sales were actually lost.
